page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan, of which only the left-hand part is shown here. Left edge: a cut-off strip of text from the neighbouring left column, its lines broken off. Centre: one main text column with running head and page number at top. Right margin, bottom: marginal note "Seldenus" with a cut-off second line.; One column of running text in the centre; narrow marginal notes at the left edge (cut and faint) and at the right edge beside the first lines.

main_text.p: fecrabatur; octuplicia vestimenta gestabat, (ubi Urim & Thumim occurrunt;) virginem in uxo-rem ducere cogebatur; templi adyta solemni ex-piationum festo ingrediebatur; ingressurus per- septem continuos dies publicè, ne fortuito centaminaretur, custodiebatur; mortem etiam- proximi cognati non lugebat; polluotus sacra- per Vicarium peragebat. Levitæ decimo ætatis initiabantur; vigesimo quinto anno per manuum impositionē consecrabant, quinquennium quæ ad officiū spectabant, discebant; a vigesimo ad quin-quagesimū, tabernaculum portabant. Emeriti ju-niores docebant, &, ne peregrinus templum in-grederetur, cavebant. Ex iisdem superiores cor-pore illæso esse debebant, & in Sanhedrin inter-dum refidebant: ab inferioribus, sola vox exige-batur, & sacerdotis se immiscere officio capitaleSeldenus erat. Idololatria circa vitulum aureum, ( qui Bih Syra CXXV. talenta ponderasse, & ex cujus in pul-verem redacti potu, rubras barbas idololatris & eorum posteris crevisse, ridicule creditur) a bove deaurato qui in Osiridis ἀΦανισμῶ & Δήσεσι pulla veste byssina amictus,ab Hierophantis,qua-tuor diebus continuis, ostendebatur, initiumDuret. Hi- traxit, & ante legem latam contigit. Quod Lin-{f}ßor. Judaicis Doctoribus credimus, conjecit Moses le-gur. c. 8.gem à DEO datam in tredecim exemplaria ; quorum duodecim literis Samaritanis scripta, totidem tribubus servanda dedit; decimum ter-tium charactere secreto ex jod triangularibus constante, Levitis & Sacerdotibus reliquit, &c. page.notes: Left-edge fragments are cut off and only partly legible; the lines of the neighbouring column are not transcribed in full. The right-hand marginal note is cut off at the foot of this part. Marginal notes at left are cut and mostly illegible; the right-margin notes are partly illegible. Catchword "mo" at the foot is taken as the catchword of the next page.
